scope: Read-only review of polygon extrusion, hole triangulation, normal orientation, float precision, meshopt quantization, feature-ID sidecars, height precedence, and suppression/replacement counts. No production or app files modified.

material_findings.summary: Suppressed parent volume was entirely omitted when any building part existed, although parts could cover only a small fraction of the parent footprint.
material_findings.location: fetch_fullcity.py renderable assignment; propagated by build_fullcity_models.py create_meshes skip and legacy build_district_models.py export_one parent skip.
material_findings.evidence: 17 suppressed parents in tile 14/13720/6694 inspected with all surrounding 8 owner tiles (27,184 features). 12 parent footprints had <95% part coverage; Golden Bell Plaza 14.290622%, Lansheng Building 32.549881%, Hongtai parent 8.392822%.
material_findings.resolution: Global exact parent-minus-union(parts) override file is now integrated. Relevant per-source residual hash invalidates changed owner cells; unaffected old meshes remain reusable. Original parent tower height/floors are not reused as podium height; residual footprints get explicitly labeled estimates.
material_findings.resolution_status: source_fix_reviewed_and_representative_residuals_verified; final full-city completion audit still required

passed_checks.sidecar_ids: All original IDs in each sampled whole-cell output were present, with only permitted parent IDs added. Checks include nonrenderable parents for online overlap suppression.
passed_checks.hashes_and_headers: Sample GLB SHA256, file length, required meshopt/quantization extensions, and exact triangle counts match records.

nonblocking_precision_notes.details: 42 complete-parent residuals of total area <=1 m² are intentionally omitted; aggregate omitted area 22.635866 m². This is an explicit numerical mesh policy, not evidence those areas do not exist.

The mesh writer also removes consecutive vertices closer than 1 mm and rings below 0.01 m². Among retained parent residuals, 94 tiny exterior components are skipped, total area 0.1047021300 m², largest 0.0093729406 m². Record these separately; the phrase all small components remain intact is only true for the override GeoJSON, not its final mesh.

create_meshes fails if every polygon of a feature fails; a partly successful MultiPolygon is counted as a represented feature and failed components are recorded. Therefore final validation must inspect invalid_polygons and their areas; feature-count balance alone is not geometry-area completeness.

build_district_models.py export_one still skips a complete parent when any child part is present. Full-city production imports its geometry helpers only; rebuilding legacy district samples through that entrypoint would retain the original omission unless separately adapted.

operational_notes: The generic >100 MB assertion in write_glb runs before publish_chunk can split it; a pathological >100 MB raw owner cell would fail visibly rather than split. Observed source cells are far smaller, so this does not affect current production.

Changed partitioning on a rerun can leave orphan records unless cleanup/audit rejects them. Current sample had no split owner cells; final audit should enforce that every record belongs to exactly one source state.

Code-source checksums should accompany the published build. Per-source residual hashes correctly permit unaffected pre-fix cells to be reused; do not interpret this as generic cache invalidation for all future geometry changes.
